# Permission-expanding lifecycle fixture

G5 LIFE-05 only. Overlay these two files in an isolated checkout at the normal Labels manifest paths. It changes version0.2.1 to0.2.2 and requests the already-defined Notes notes.write capability. Runtime handlers, schemas, native model and UI remain unchanged; no migration is required. Both workspace grants must appear in the exact independent upgrade plan and require explicit permission acknowledgment. The default reference plugin continues to request only notes.read; this fixture is not a new product feature or a sandbox claim.
